title: ReCo: When to Relocate Sensor Kits under Deployment Constraints -- A NILM Case Study
abstract: arXiv:2609.35075v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many sensing tasks obtain training labels only by deploying instruments in the field. With a limited number of sensor kits, a collection deadline, and measurement downtime at every move, the collector must repeatedly decide whether to stay at the current site or relocate. We study this decision in non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM), which estimates the power drawn by individual appliances from a home's main meter and is trained on data from homes temporarily fitted with appliance-level sub-meters. In NILM, appliance usage varies with the appliance, season and climate, and the value of new data depends on how diverse the combinations of target operation and background load are. To address this, we propose a constraint-based relocation framework and instantiate it for NILM as ReCo (Relocation by Coverage gain). translated_title: ReCo：在部署约束下何时迁移传感器套件——一个NILM案例研究
translated_abstract: 许多感知任务只能通过在现场部署仪器来获取训练标签。在传感器套件数量有限、存在采集截止期限、且每次迁移都会造成测量停机的情况下，采集者必须反复决定是留在当前站点还是进行迁移。我们在非侵入式负荷监测（NILM）中研究这一决策问题。NILM通过住宅的主电表估计各个电器的用电量，其训练数据来自临时安装了电器级子电表的住宅。在NILM中，电器的使用情况随电器类型、季节和气候而变化，新数据的价值取决于目标运行状态与背景负荷组合的多样性程度。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一个基于约束的迁移决策框架，并针对NILM将其实现为ReCo（基于覆盖增益的迁移）。ReCo在联合的目标-背景特征空间中统计新的运行状态，并预测每个住宅未来可带来的增益……
tldr: 提出了一种基于约束的传感器套件迁移决策框架ReCo，通过在目标-背景联合特征空间中统计新运行状态并预测各住宅的未来数据增益，解决NILM数据采集中“何时迁移”的决策问题。
en_tdlr: ReCo is a constraint-based relocation framework that decides when to move sensor kits in NILM data collection by counting new operating regimes in a joint target-background feature space and forecasting each home's future data gain.
